title: The Amazing Randi vs. Pseudoscience
description:
James Randi, the legendary magician and skeptic, exposed frauds like Uri Geller, Peter Popoff, Sylvia Browne, and countless others. Known as The Amazing Randi, he was a pioneer in debunking paranormal claims, pseudoscience, and alternative medicine. From his Million Dollar Challenge to his iconic Tonight Show appearances, Randi dedicated his life to truth, critical thinking, and scientific temper.

If you’ve searched for James Randi biography, Amazing Randi, Uri Geller exposed, Peter Popoff fraud, Sylvia Browne debunked, Million Dollar Challenge, paranormal hoaxes, skeptic legends, magician debunking pseudoscience, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations about science and skepticism.
